pages.text: CAPTAIN WILLIAMSON A. SANGMA A’chikrangni gisepo skanggipa Captain, Garo Hills District Councilni Chief Executive Member, Meghalaya A’dokni skanggipa Chief Minister aro Governor ong’chenggipa. Salrang re’anga, kattarang dongkama. Uni kamrang gisik ra’beani ong’a. MEGHALAYA A’DOK ONG'BACHENGA. CAPTAIN WILLIAMSON A. jakkalania dalroro-silrorona dakchaka. Iani bebe ong’aniko Captain W.A. Sangmani janggi tanganio rongtalen mesoka. An’tangni segipa ki’tap “Captain Williamson A. Sangma” -ko pringsao ra’bae, uko poraie, agansoaniko see onpachina Pa. Mihir N. Sangma (Munepa) angko molomon anga jajrenga gnang kurachakrikaha maina ia dal’gipa mandeni gimin angni u’iani namen komiachim. Ki’tapko poraie nion anga Captain S an g ma ni bi’samitingo duk chake janggi tanganiko aro uni chonmitingo neng’nikanirangko chakchike, uarangko badee amaniko nikon, uarang angko gisik nangatbeaha. Bang’a A’chikrangan anggita Captain Sangmani bi’samitingo janggi tangani gimin u’ipajaenggen ine anga chanchia. Uni janggi tangani A’chik bi’sarangna nambegipa skie ra’ani aro an’tangtangko mikkangchi namgipa songdonggiparang ong’na aro mandesal dilgipa ong’na didiatani ong’gen ine anga ka’donga Ki’tapko poraigiparang iano Captain Sangmani j an g gi tanganiko aro uni chu’sokanikosan nikaijawa indiba ua maikai jatna ka’saaha aro a’brini a’dokni sorkariko man’na rakbee tikeldilaha aro gisik gnangbee kamko ka’dilaha uko nikrikna man’a. Bebeko aganode, ia ki’tap Indiani salgro-salaramni a’brini a’dokrango a’brini jatrangni an’tangtangni nangnikani gita bewalrangko rakkina aro namdapatrorona are a’dokrangni silroro-namroro gnipn an’tangtangni sorkariko songe sason ka’anina tikel anirangko aro mongsongde, dao Meghalayao donggipa a’brini jatrangni ka’nilanirangko name sandirikkite segimin ong'a. Ia ki’tapan A’chik ku’sikode indake sandirikkite segiminrangoni skanggipa ong’a ine anga chanchia. (Hi) Captain Sangamani mongsongbatgipa •dhfc’sokani aro rasong chaani a’sel gnang-maina ua gipin gipin Indiani salgro-salaramni a’dokrango daka gita Indiani Ma’dot Sorkarini kosako bobil dake chakatdilgija aro an’chi-pan naatgija batesa tom’tomao jinmako dabiatangko tikkeldile Meghalayako man’dile on’aha. Ian uni gisik gnanganiko, namgipa dilgipa ong’aniko aro jatko re’dilanio chu’sokaniko bilake mesoka. Indiani dal’dalgipa a’songni dilgiparangba iani a’selan uko mandera’a aro uni kattarangko rongjrime ra’a. Captain Sangma Meghalayaosanmangmang dilgipa ong’aija indiba Indiani salgro-salaramni a’dokrango aro India a’song gimikoba mongsonggipa dilgiparangoni saksa ine chanako

man’pagipa ong’a. Ia ki’tapo Indiani jakgitelko manani jamano Indiani salgro-salaram a’dokrango maidakgipa obostarang ong’angaha aro maikai dingtangdingtangdolrang maidakgipa ka’nilanirangko dakangaha uko nikna man ’an baksa Captain Sangmani jak indakgipa ka’nilani kamrango baditana kingking dongachim uko poraina man’gen. Ia ki’tapko segipa Pa. Mihir N. Sangma (Munepa) neng’bee sandirikkite uarangko chimongaha aro ki’tapni bimango ong’ate A’chik manderangna Meghalayani ong’baani gimin rongtalbee mesoke on’aha aro iana anga uko mittela. Ia ki’tap A’chikrangna aro gipin jatrangnaba nambe gipa aro bang’a ma’sidapanirangko raljagen ine anga bebera’a. Dated Tura, Sd/ K.M.Momin, The 24th August, 1991. 24.8.91 Addl. D.P.I. (iv) JANAPCHENGANIRANG A’chikrangni dakbewal ka’bcwalrangni bidingo chanchibewalani tom’bimonganiko Shillongo donggipa A’chikrangni, “Literature are Cultural Society” ba dol, 1984 bilsini April jani 13 aro 14 tarikrango Shillong songjinmao ong’ataha. Ua tom’aniona bakrangko ra’pae tom’a niatchotkujanakingking anga Shillongon dongaha. Tom’agimik anga Pa. William Cecil R. Marakni dongchakgipa noko uamang baksaan dongpaaha. Ua somoio Pa. William Cecil R. Marak, Meghalaya A’dok Sorkarini Civil Supply, Weaving aro Sericulture Department ni State Minister ong’engachim. Garo Literature aro Cultural Societyni ua tom’aniona re’baenggipa mandorangna sokachaksona tarigimin noko anga dongejaha. Anlangni chawari demechik ong’ani gimin Pa. William Cecil R. Marakni dongchakenggipa nokon anga ma’chakna namnikbataha. Namgipa sokachakanirangna anga uamangni nokdangko mitelpilna gualja. la tom’bimongani, 1984 bilsini April jani 14 gipa tarikon matchotaha. Indake 15 gipa tarikni pringo cha aro cha’anirangko ringman chamane neng’take dongengmitingo, angni chawari, Pa. William Cecil R. Marak angko Meghalaya A’dok Sorkarini Matbol (Chief Minister) Captain Williamson Sangmaona rona mong’kaaha. Anga kusi ong’bee un baksa

re’angpa’aha. Anga re’angengmitingpn ru’uta salonin angni miksongani aro nangnikani kattarangko Captain Williamson A. Sangmao sing’anirangko dakna man’ode namgenchim ine chanthijoljolangaha. Uni janggi tangani obostarangko uo sing’s ra’na miksonganian ua somoio angni mongsongbatgipa chanchiani ong’achim. Indiba ia miksonganirang chu’sokgipa ong’gen ba ongjawa, jajrengani ango dongachim. Captain Williamson A. Sangmako angni grongeani somoi, 1984 ’bilsini April jani 15 gipa tarik, Robibar pring aro uni ma’chakenggipa nokrii dringo pringni 11 bajioni 1:10 bajiona, anga an’tangni nangnikanirangko sing’e ra’aha. (v) Ua somoiosa anga Captain Williamson A. Sangmako grongchenga ong'ja. Bilsi 1948 intalan anga uko nikchengaha. Una agreba uni Garo Hills District Councilni Chief Executive Member ong’engmitingo anga uni ning’o, District Council Office kamko 1955*56 bilsirango ka’aha. Separate Hills State •na uni kam ka’e wenroromitingoba gisep gisep anga un baksa dingtang dingtang biaprangona re’roropaaha. Indiba ua pringo angni grongagita damsan asongrime agangrikanirangko anga dakkujachim. Angni grongchengmitingo : Anga Captain Williamson A. Sangmako uni dongchakram nokni asongram biapo, saksa uko grongna reTaagipa mande baksa agangrikenganiko nikeaha. Anga aro angni chawarigipa, apsan kuturion Captain Sangmako mikkangchake asongeaha. Agangrikmanahaon dongsoenggipa agital mande ua kuturioni re’ongkatangaha. Uni re’angani ja’mano, bak tapan Captain Sangma chingko kuturi ge’gipinona rimangskaaha. Ua somoio chinga sakgittamna agrede uano darangba dongjachim. Uni gimin anga angni nangnikanirangko uo sing’e ra’na namen chol ong’beaha. A’chikrangni aganani bewalo, an’tangna bribatgipa, uibatgipa manderangko okamna ba agangrikna jakkalanio, “mama, ada, awang ba pajong” ba ua indake minga de’anian gamchatgipa mande ra’aniko mesokani ong’a ine anga chanchia. Indake anga unbaksa agangrikanirango uko “mama” ine janape an’tangni nanganirangko sing’e ra’na a*bachengaha. Bang’s jrimgipa, ning’tubegipa chanchina nanganirangchi dal’gipa aro ugita dilgipa manderangni

gisikrang jakgitele dongrongja aro chanchisimsime tom’tomanirangko man’na amja. Indiba ua pringni somoio jedake ka’sina aro tom’tom ong’a, indaken uni gisik aro chanchianirangoba ka’sina aro katchaani donga gita nika. Anga rasong gnange indonga somoiko uano chagrongaha aro nanganirangko sing’e ra’na cholrangko man’aha. Janggi tanganiko seanio anga uko mitelmikna ba namgyanirangko am’rikitna ine miksongani dongja. Indiba (vi) chong’motko sandie indakgipa manderangni janggi tanganirangko, kam aro ga’anggimin ja’kolrangko sandi-ripinge jaman jawilo dongrikgipa chadamberangna gisik ra’ani aro nirik-nikgrikpae A’songtang chigatangna nambatroroe kam ka’na ja’ku de’anio sakantikon didiani kam ongchinasa miksongbata. Ian chu’sokgipa seani ine anga agana man’ja. Gualanirang aro watchanganirang dongnaba donga. Iako namdapatna aro chu'sokbatatna gita skia man’gipa sakantini kam ong*a. Namdapatna aro chu’sokbatatna dakchakgipa sakantikon anga mitelbegen. Jeje manderangoniko anga sandie seanirangko dakaha, uan angni nangnikani gimin sandianiko dakaha ong’ja. Indiba, iarango pangchake sandie seanirangko dakchina gita angna Captain Williamson A. Sangma an’tangan Pa. Debendra Baruah, Rev. Jonnah Ch. Sangma aro Ma. Bisadini Sangma, sakgittam manderangni bimungrangko minge on’aha. Uamangko anga gronge bang’a-kon man’dapaha. Uamangko mitelna anga gualjawa. Ki’tapo on’chapgipa gitcham photorangko angna Captain Sangmani Jikgipa, Ma. Betty Devis Ch. Momin jaksrambeen on’aha. Iana anga namen mitelbea. Salantio bang 1 a dakna nanggni kamrangko dongale angni segiminrangko che’em che’em poraie niani jamano gamchatbegipa kattarangchi ki’tapo segiminrangna “AGANSOANI”-ko Pa. K.M. Momin (Saljongpa) on’dape gamchatbatataniko dakaha. Angni gisik katong gimikchi anga uko mitelpilna gualja. Angni sechimonggiminrangko ki’tapni bimang ong’atna gisik sikbeoba angna apnikgijani ong’engon, uko chapa ka’ate matchotatna Captain Sangmani demechik Ma. Veronica Ch.Momin dakchakaniko on’aha, indake da’o k’itapko jinmana nakatatpana gita chol ong’aha. Uni ia dakchakanina anga gro nanggipa ong’a. Angni sinakrip uko mitelangkugen.

Sangma-ni aganchakani kattarang. Anga : (Mikkangchakgrike asonge) Mama, nangni janggi tangani aro kamrangni gimin saoba saoba chimonganirangko dakengahama? na’a antangba see donanirang dongenggenkon. Capt. Sangma : “Baosa, darangba dongkuja. R.T.Rimbaisa gisik nangengakonchim, iarangni gimin ango sing’e ra’ronga. Baditanakingkingong’ahachim, anga uija. Anga antangde mamungko dakan dongja.” Anga : Bebegitaba na’a antangde jakchakjawa, mai bilsio atchia, 'uko gisik rakuengama? Capt. Sangma : “Gisik ra’a, 1919 bilsini, October jani 18 gipa tariko atchia. Anga : Atchiade Baghmaraon atchiakonde mama. Capt. Sangma : “Oe, Baghmaraon atchia. Angni atchichakgipa biapde Baghmara Bazar gitcham, Simsang chibimani rikamon onga.” (Ua biap daode dongjaha, Simsang chibima a’dram pe’roroe Simsang chikol ongaha.) Anga : Ambi sagini bimungkoara mai mingachimsai? Captain Sangma : “Ama sagikode Nomall ini minga. Baba sagikoara Gongsin minga.” (Magipa sagini bimungko minge on’na skangde ontisa chanchichengna nangaha. Pagipani chugimik bimungara, Pa. Gongsin Sintang Marak aro Magipani chugimik bimungde Ma. Nomallini Ampang Sangma ongachim.) Anga : Na’an barimaonide chonbatgipamo? Captain Williamson A. Sangma Capt. Sangma : “Angni chonbatgipa nogipa dongachimnakon, chonkuengmitingon siaha. Angaba chonkuengani gimin ma’sirikjaha. Angni aro nang mama Minapa (Hekinson A. Sangma) sagini chonkuengmitingon babara siaha. Baba sagini ja’mano ang adatang dal*batgipaan Baba sagini badinganikoba nosto ka’e bon’ataha. Nang mama Minapa aro angade ramram mandegitasa dal’bapa'aiaha Chinga adasa Baghmara Bazaro cha dokan dakeba palbapa’aha. Angni adatang dal*batgipakoara, Rameswar A. Sangma minga, Alter aro Lalitmangni pagipa sagi. Bian baba sagini done sianggipa tangka paisarangkoba bon’atokaha aro uni ja’manode mamungan dongsrangjaha.” W.C. Marak : “Badia Lalit, Turani Puranpagipama?” Anga : Oe, Turani Puranpagipa Lalitanba.

W.C. Marak : “Oh, Lalitmangni pagipaan nang’ni adatang darbatgipamo, indakesan bisongaramikkangbimangrang na'simang baksa apsana.” Anga : Oe, ba’rimarangni gisepode mandeba chanangbata aro an’gilba nambata ine ukon manderang janaptoka. Primary Schoolkode songon matchotama aro M.E. Schoolkode Turaosa poraiakonmo mama? Capt. Sangma : “Oe, Primaryko songon, Baghmaraon matchotba’a. Anga : Rev. Jonah-an nang , ni Primary teacher onga ine manderangni aganako anga knaa, bebemasai? Capt. Sangma : “Oe, Rev. Jonah-an angni Primary teacher ong’a. Head Masterde Binaram Sangma aro Prafulla K. Sangmaba angni Primary teacher onga. Rev. Jonah-de tangpakuenga. Sakgnide siangtokaha. Anga : Uni kride Rev. Jonah-de rakpakuenga. W.C. Marak : “Oh, da'o Turao dongenggipa Rev. Jonah-anma? ” Capt. Sangma : “Oe, ukonba aganenga, uanba angni Primary teacher onga.” Anga : Indakenba mama na’ara maikaesa M.E. ko Turao poraiani ong^aha aro maikae Turaona sokbaaha? Awang 2 Captain Williamson A. Sangma Winniepamangara (Emarson Ch. Mom in) Baghmaraoq dongachimkonke . Capt. Sangma : “Bao ong’ja, abiko bia ka’namangmangsan gumede Baghmaraona re’angaiaba. Biara Turaon, Teachers, Training Schoolni Superintendent dake kam ka’enga. Indake uasa angko Turao poraiatna rimbaaha. Anga 1929 bilsio dal’gipa banggria ong’na bilsisa skangan Turaona re'bachengaha. 1930 bilsio dal'gipa banggriakon anga gisik ra’kuenga. M.E.Schoolo poraimitingo angara Sonatchipagipa (Late Eveline R. Marak) sagi baksa damsan class. Indiba bian angna batede namen lekka manTjata.” “Pangnan biade classo skanggipa ong’rongaia. Angade gnigipa dakesa ong’paia. Chinga class IV-o poraimitingonin Sonatchipa sagi baksa phai kana (ripeng daka) ine English-chi chiti segrika. Unonin phaiba kaa.” Uni jamano Capt. Williamson A. Sangma indake aganangkuaha :

“Turao class V-ko matchotman’o angni gumetanggipa angko Nishangram M.E. Schoolona poraiatnagita rimbaskaaha. Unomiting angni gumetang, Winniepagipara Goalpara High Schoolo Garo Vernacularko skiengachim. Indake Nishangram M.E. Schoolo class VI ko matchote poraiaha. Ua somoio anga Middle Scholarshipko man’paa. Nishangramo donge poraimiting somoirango anga Kokapa (Kosan G. Momin) aro Ronggepa (Dejing Mistri) mangni nokchi rorongpa’aha.” “Nishangramo angni poraimitingo angni Head Masterde Pa. Debendra Baruahan ong’achim. Ua da’onaba tangpakuenga. Uni ja’mano anga 1934 oni 37 bilsirango Goalpara High Schoolo poraie 1938 bilsio Matric porikako pass ka’aha. 1939-40 bilsio Dacca-o poraie I A. (Intermediate o£ Arts) porikako pass ka’aha. Uni ja’manosa 1941-42 bilsirango Calcuttani Srirampore Collegeo B.A. ko poraiaha. 1942 bilsio anga B.A. finalko porika seenba Turaona pil’bapilaha.” 3 Captain Williamson A. Sangma Captain Wiliamson A. Sangma indake aganangkuaha. “1942 bilsini August jao gnigipa dakgrikanio anga napange N.C.O. trainingko Daccao ra’aha. Trainingoni joljolan anga 1942 bilsini December jao Comissioned Rank-o Lieutenant dake kamko man’aha. Angni bilsi unomiting bilsi 25-san ong’kuaiengani gimin, bilsi chu’ongkuja ine Major Rank-ko angna on’pajaha. 1946 bilsini February jao anga dakgrikani kamoni Turaona pil’bapilaha.” (Ua dakgrikao kam kae Captain-ni Rank-onade sokdona man’aha.) “Dakgrikaoni re’bapile anga 1947 bilsio Turaon Multipurpose Cooperative Society-ni Secretary dake kamkoba ka’aha. Uni ja’manosa 1948 bilsio anga Deputy Commissionerni ning’o Rural Development Officer dake kam ka’skaaha.” Anga : Mama na’ara mai bilsimango bia ka’achim? Capt. Sangma s “1948 bilsio, indiba sal aro tarikrangkode tik ong’e uijaengaha.” (unon ua on’tisa ka’dingsmita gnang, bia ka’ani Certificate-ni gimin janapjolenba, sandina nanggen ine aganaha.) Anga : Basakonisa na’ara jatna kam ka’na a’bachengaha? Capt. Sangma : “Angni Politics-o jak on’chengade 1946-47 bilsirangonin ongToaaha. 1946 bilsio Garo National

Conference- ni Pa. Modi K. Marak-an President ong’a aro Pa. Emonsing M. Sangmara General Secretary dake ong’engachim. Unomitingo doltangtangni gisepon adita meligrikgijanirang ong’kataha. Indake angko Pa. Modi K. Markak-ni pal Garo National Conference-ni President dakatskaaha.” Captain Williamson A. Sangma indake aganangkuaha. “Angni chonmiting salrangni gimin talbate aro rongtalbate ma’sina sikode angni abitang Loreth-magipao (Ma. Bisadini A. Sangma) singlx). Haida, una agreba saobarangba uiengkunaba dongakon. Angni politics-o kam ka’baanirangni giminde angaba che’em che’em dakede talpiljajok. Gitcham see rakianirangko (Records) nipiltaiosa uina manpiltaignok.” 4 Captain Williamson A. Sangma “(Indakmiting somoion angni chawari, Pa. William Cecil R. Marak, angni sakgni demechikrang Chandigarh-o poraienggipa, Sane aro Sume-mangni koborangko Delhi Meghalaya Houseona phone ka’e sin’gatengachim. Maina uamangara chuti ong’e Turaona re’baani ong’engachim aroba ua somoirango Punjab-ni mitam biaprango golmalrangba ong’engachim. Namekae rongtalbrejaengani gimin Captain Williamson Sangma an’tangan phoneko bakan jaktango ra’skae angni demechik sakgniko bakbak Plane ticket ra’e Turaona watatani cholrangko dakatchina Meghalaya Houseo kam kagipa mandena uiataniko dakaha.
